axisAdviceCoverage: Author a central advice carrier in slices/grounding/logic/module.ttl for each of the slice's advisory-prose cells the advisor names. For an avoidWhen cell: a logic:Constraint + logic:Formula whose data-matching guard detects the anti-pattern, at logic:severity "Info", with logic:formalizes naming the term, logic:adviceSourceField logic:ProseFieldAvoidWhen, and logic:message set to the term's verbatim avoidWhen prose — so it fires a deonticRecommendation Note when an individual matches. For a useWhen cell: a logic:AdviceGuidance that logic:formalizes the term, with logic:adviceSourceField logic:ProseFieldUseWhen and logic:message the verbatim useWhen prose. The native verify gate holds each message to the term's current prose. The domain slice keeps only its prose; the carrier lives centrally and formalizes the term.

axisDocMaturity: Cover the documentation-maturity dimensions the advisor names (the FULL-anchor coat the slice is short) to raise its gmeow:coverageFraction; the maturity standard is owned by slices/core/documentation and consumed as-is. Raising this slice's committed floor — by editing the ontology-resident gmeow:AxisFloorCommitment individual for that (slice, axis) in this slice-quality-rubric slice (generated/governance/slice-quality-axis-floors.tsv is a read-only projection of those individuals, never edited by hand) — is a separate, deliberate uplift commit once the measured coverage has genuinely risen; the gate enforces non-regression at the committed floor, never automatic ascent.
axisDocumentation: Write a narrative docs.md thesis — substantive prose beyond the headings, not a term listing — for the slice (SLICE_GUIDE documentation doctrine).

axisGmn1Coverage: Round-trip each uncovered GMN-0 construct the advisor names: extend the GMN-1 codec's covered fragment (crates/lang-bridge/src/gmn1_codec.rs) so gmn1_write/gmn1_read carry it losslessly, or — if the construct is genuinely out of the codec's current design scope — file it as a named codec-coverage gap against LANG-GMN.md rather than leaving it silently unmeasured. Raising this slice's committed floor — by editing the ontology-resident gmeow:AxisFloorCommitment individual for that (slice, axis) in this slice-quality-rubric slice (generated/governance/slice-quality-axis-floors.tsv is a read-only projection of those individuals, never edited by hand) — is a separate, deliberate uplift commit made once the measured score has genuinely risen; the gate enforces non-regression at the committed floor, never automatic ascent.

axisGmnGlyphOptimality: Disposition every audited grounding-plane symbol candidate exactly once as an adopted glyph, named key, structured constructor, or semantic rejection; add its cited rationale, candidate rendering, ASCII fallback, spoken label, and decision basis; and make adopted signs executable through a scoped lang:Denotation-backed glyph registry binding whose measured token cost does not lose to the fallback.

axisHarvestCoverage: Author the definitional obligation as executable logic: in slices/grounding/logic/module.ttl for each term the advisor names — a logic:Constraint at logic:severity "Violation" or "Warning" with its logic:Formula guard, or a standalone logic:Formula, carrying logic:formalizes naming the term whose skos:definition it realizes. Harvest the semantics the definition already states; do not mint OWL/RDFS/gUFO axioms while translating (Principle 4/17/19 — those are generated projections, not authoring surfaces). The domain slice keeps only its prose; the axiom lives centrally and formalizes the term.

axisMaximalLinkage: Route each hand-authored identity-strength alignment record through the correspondence calculus: lift a hand-authored alignment cell to a mnemomorphic gmeow:ProjectionMapping "=" cell, and derive each dc: alignment through the dcterms:→dc: dumb-down rather than authoring the dc: alignment by hand (Principle 17).
axisOptimalTesting: Add at least one test cell or competency query naming each currently-unreached term so every term in the slice is exercised (SLICE_GUIDE §9; SLICE_QA).

axisTranslationCoverage: Add audited French and Mandarin translations for every localizable literal the slice authors — labels, comments, definitions, scope notes, examples, pref/alt labels, notes, titles, descriptions, names — recorded (non-empty msgstr) in the slice's i18n/fr.po and i18n/zh.po catalogs.
